ex1_mcq.title: Exercise 1: Multiple Choice Questions
ex1_mcq.instruction: Choose the best option (A, B, C, or D) that correctly uses articles (a, an, the, or Ø for zero article).

questions.text: Many exchange students experience ______ culture shock when they first encounter unfamiliar customs in a foreign country.
questions.explanation: 'Culture shock' là danh từ không đếm được dùng với nghĩa chung khái quát, do đó ta dùng mạo từ zero (Ø).

questions.text: During the autumn carnival, children carried ______ colourful pumpkin lantern through the illuminated village square.
questions.explanation: Danh từ đếm được số ít 'pumpkin lantern' lần đầu được đề cập, đứng sau tính từ bắt đầu bằng phụ âm 'colourful', dùng mạo từ bất định 'a'.

questions.text: The international marine expedition sailed across ______ Atlantic Ocean to investigate endangered coral reefs.
questions.explanation: Dùng mạo từ xác định 'the' trước tên của các đại dương (the Atlantic Ocean).

questions.text: After exploring the floating market in the Mekong Delta, Liam bought ______ unique hand-woven scarf as a souvenir.
questions.explanation: Tính từ 'unique' bắt đầu bằng âm bán nguyên âm /juː/, do đó dùng mạo từ bất định 'a' chứ không dùng 'an'.

questions.text: In our high school, participating in an extracurricular activity is considered ______ excellent way to appreciate cultural diversity.
questions.explanation: Danh từ số ít đếm được đi kèm tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm ('excellent') dùng mạo từ bất định 'an'.

questions.text: The tourists stopped at a lively night market. ______ food stall they visited was famous for its spicy noodles and authentic broth.
questions.explanation: Danh từ 'food stall' được nhắc lại lần thứ hai và đã được xác định cụ thể trong ngữ cảnh, nên dùng mạo từ 'The'.

questions.text: Our music teacher encouraged everyone in the class to learn to play ______ traditional guitar or the bamboo flute.
questions.explanation: Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước danh từ chỉ nhạc cụ khi đi với động từ 'play' hoặc 'learn to play'.

questions.text: Every morning, my host family in Ha Noi has ______ breakfast together before going to work and school.
questions.explanation: Tên các bữa ăn thông thường trong ngày (breakfast, lunch, dinner) dùng zero article (Ø).

questions.text: Last summer, an international youth delegation traveled to ______ United Kingdom to attend a conference on globalisation.
questions.explanation: Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước tên quốc gia có chứa từ 'Kingdom' (the United Kingdom).

questions.text: During the highland festival, teenagers enthusiastically took part in ______ bamboo dancing on the central stage.
questions.explanation: Tên các điệu nhảy truyền thống hoặc môn thể thao/trò chơi dân gian dùng zero article (Ø).

questions.text: The guest speaker gave ______ inspiring lecture on how world cuisines influence modern eating trends.
questions.explanation: Cụm danh từ số ít 'inspiring lecture' bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm /ɪ/ nên dùng mạo từ 'an'.

questions.text: Astronomers gathered in the observatory to observe ______ moon during the lunar eclipse celebration.
questions.explanation: Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước các thiên thể và thực thể duy nhất trong tự nhiên (the sun, the moon, the earth).

questions.text: The local chef explained that lemongrass is ______ essential ingredient in crafting authentic Vietnamese noodle soup.
questions.explanation: Danh từ đếm được số ít 'ingredient' đi sau tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm 'essential' (/ɪˈsenʃl/), dùng 'an'.

questions.text: Students from various ethnic backgrounds gathered in ______ capital city to celebrate their shared cultural identity.
questions.explanation: Thủ đô của một quốc gia là thực thể xác định duy nhất trong ngữ cảnh đó, do đó dùng mạo từ 'the'.

questions.text: My pen pal lives in ______ Japan, where ancient temples stand alongside futuristic skyscrapers.
questions.explanation: Tên hầu hết các quốc gia ở dạng số ít thông thường (như Japan, Viet Nam, France) không dùng mạo từ (zero article Ø).

questions.text: The students felt a slight chill as they stepped into ______ haunted house built for the charity carnival.
questions.explanation: Danh từ số ít 'haunted house' được giới thiệu lần đầu, từ 'haunted' bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm /h/, dùng mạo từ 'a'.

questions.text: Mount Fansipan is officially recognised as ______ highest mountain peak in the entire Indochinese region.
questions.explanation: Trước tính từ so sánh nhất ('the highest') luôn dùng mạo từ xác định 'the'.

questions.text: On October 31st, children in many Western countries dress up in scary costumes and go ______ trick or treating.
questions.explanation: Cụm thành ngữ và hoạt động lễ hội 'go trick or treating' / 'play trick or treat' không sử dụng mạo từ (zero article Ø).

questions.text: Overcoming ______ language barrier is one of the most rewarding challenges for participants in culture exchange programs.
questions.explanation: Danh từ đếm được số ít 'language barrier' được nói tới một cách khái quát mang nghĩa 'một rào cản', dùng 'a'.

questions.text: In the 21st century, ______ globalisation has accelerated the exchange of ideas, art forms, and cultural practices worldwide.
questions.explanation: 'Globalisation' là danh từ trừu tượng không đếm được dùng với ý nghĩa khái quát toàn cầu, dùng mạo từ zero (Ø).

ex2_verbform.title: Exercise 2: Article & Sentence Completion
ex2_verbform.instruction: Complete each sentence with the correct article: a, an, the, or Ø (zero article).

questions.text: Many international students experience culture shock when they first arrive in (article) ______ United States.
questions.explanation: Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước tên quốc gia có từ 'States' (the United States).

questions.text: During their field trip to the northern highlands, the volunteers enjoyed watching (article) ______ bamboo dancing performed by Tay villagers.
questions.explanation: Tên các điệu múa truyền thống và trò chơi dân gian dùng zero article (Ø).

questions.text: Globalisation has opened up (article) ______ unprecedented opportunity for young Vietnamese people to experience cross-cultural learning.
questions.explanation: Danh từ số ít 'opportunity' đi sau tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm 'unprecedented' (/ʌnˈpresɪdentɪd/), dùng 'an'.

questions.text: My cousin practices playing (article) ______ piano every afternoon to prepare for the school's multicultural talent show.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'the' trước tên nhạc cụ khi đi với động từ chỉ việc luyện tập hoặc chơi nhạc cụ ('playing the piano').

questions.text: Every weekend, food enthusiasts flock to the night bazaar to savour delicious local (article) ______ cuisine.
questions.explanation: 'Cuisine' được dùng như danh từ không đếm được chỉ ẩm thực nói chung, dùng zero article (Ø).

questions.text: The university exchange team traveled to (article) ______ Netherlands to attend an international symposium on cultural heritage.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'the' trước tên các quốc gia có dạng danh từ số nhiều (the Netherlands, the Philippines).

questions.text: At the folk art museum, the guide introduced (article) ______ unfamiliar musical instrument crafted from buffalo horn.
questions.explanation: Danh từ số ít 'musical instrument' đi kèm tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm 'unfamiliar' (/ˌʌnfəˈmɪliər/), dùng 'an'.

questions.text: Anthropologists believe that (article) ______ custom of carving turnip lanterns originated in ancient Ireland.
questions.explanation: Danh từ 'custom' được xác định cụ thể bởi cụm giới từ 'of carving turnip lanterns', nên dùng mạo từ xác định 'the'.

questions.text: Children in the residential area dressed in imaginative costumes and played (article) ______ trick or treat on Halloween evening.
questions.explanation: Tên hoạt động/phong tục truyền thống 'trick or treat' dùng zero article (Ø).

questions.text: The veteran artisan delivered (article) ______ inspiring speech about preserving traditional games for future generations.
questions.explanation: Danh từ số ít 'speech' đi kèm tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm 'inspiring' (/ɪnˈspaɪərɪŋ/), dùng 'an'.

questions.text: Marine biologists are tracking how rising sea temperatures impact coral ecosystems in (article) ______ Pacific Ocean.
questions.explanation: Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước tên của các đại dương (the Pacific Ocean).

questions.text: The entire team had (article) ______ dinner together at a local food stall after winning the tug of war contest.
questions.explanation: Các danh từ chỉ bữa ăn thông thường (breakfast, lunch, dinner) dùng zero article (Ø).

questions.text: The children squealed with excitement as they entered (article) ______ haunted house during the community carnival.
questions.explanation: Danh từ số ít đếm được 'haunted house' được nhắc đến lần đầu, 'haunted' bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm /h/, dùng 'a'.

questions.text: The pastry chef emphasized that fresh vanilla is (article) ______ indispensable ingredient in authentic French desserts.
questions.explanation: Danh từ số ít 'ingredient' đi sau tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm 'indispensable' (/ˌɪndɪˈspensəbl/), dùng 'an'.

questions.text: Mount Fansipan is widely celebrated as (article) ______ highest summit in Viet Nam.
questions.explanation: Trước tính từ ở dạng so sánh nhất ('the highest') luôn dùng mạo từ xác định 'the'.

questions.text: When traveling to rural regions, foreign backpackers often encounter (article) ______ language barrier with older residents.
questions.explanation: Danh từ đếm được số ít 'language barrier' với nghĩa chung 'một rào cản ngôn ngữ', dùng 'a'.

questions.text: The youth union held (article) ______ annual cultural exchange to promote understanding among international students.
questions.explanation: Danh từ đếm được số ít đi sau tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm 'annual' (/ˈænjuəl/), dùng 'an'.

questions.text: Educators believe that young people should learn to respect (article) ______ cultural diversity in our interconnected world.
questions.explanation: 'Cultural diversity' là danh từ không đếm được dùng với ý nghĩa khái quát, dùng zero article (Ø).

questions.text: She purchased a conical hat at the souvenir shop, and (article) ______ souvenir was carefully signed by the local artisan.
questions.explanation: Danh từ 'souvenir' đã được xác định cụ thể do đã nhắc đến món đồ lưu niệm ở mệnh đề trước, dùng 'the'.

questions.text: In the modern digital era, (article) ______ internet has become the primary platform for broadcasting global cultural trends.
questions.explanation: Thực thể duy nhất và phổ quát 'the internet' luôn đi với mạo từ xác định 'the'.

ex4_rewrite.title: Exercise 4: Sentence Transformation
ex4_rewrite.instruction: Rewrite each sentence using the cue provided so that it has the same meaning as the original sentence, paying close attention to article usage.

questions.original_sentence: Vietnamese cuisine is renowned worldwide because it combines fresh herbs and balanced flavours.
questions.correct_answer: The cuisine of Viet Nam is renowned worldwide for its blend of fresh herbs and balanced flavours.
acceptable_answers: The cuisine of Viet Nam is renowned worldwide for its blend of fresh herbs and balanced flavours.
The cuisine of Viet Nam is renowned worldwide because it combines fresh herbs and balanced flavours.
questions.explanation: Chuyển tính từ chỉ quốc tịch 'Vietnamese cuisine' thành cụm danh từ xác định 'The cuisine of Viet Nam'.

questions.original_sentence: She was the first student who gave a presentation on cultural diversity in our seminar.
questions.cue: She was the first student to
questions.correct_answer: She was the first student to give a presentation on cultural diversity in our seminar.
acceptable_answers: She was the first student to give a presentation on cultural diversity in our seminar.
She was the first student to present on cultural diversity in our seminar.
questions.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ sau số thứ tự 'the first student' bằng động từ nguyên mẫu có to ('to give').

questions.original_sentence: People believe that globalisation has a profound influence on modern youth culture.
questions.correct_answer: Globalisation is believed to have a profound influence on modern youth culture.
acceptable_answers: Globalisation is believed to have a profound influence on modern youth culture.
questions.explanation: Chuyển đổi câu bị động với động từ tường thuật, giữ nguyên danh từ trừu tượng 'Globalisation' với mạo từ zero.

questions.original_sentence: No other tourist attraction in our province is as popular as the ancient citadel.
questions.correct_answer: The ancient citadel is the most popular tourist attraction in our province.
acceptable_answers: The ancient citadel is the most popular tourist attraction in our province.
questions.explanation: Chuyển từ so sánh bằng phủ định sang so sánh nhất với mạo từ xác định 'the most popular tourist attraction'.

questions.original_sentence: She bought an elaborate costume yesterday, and it was crafted from organic silk.
questions.correct_answer: The elaborate costume that she bought yesterday was crafted from organic silk.
acceptable_answers: The elaborate costume that she bought yesterday was crafted from organic silk.
The elaborate costume which she bought yesterday was crafted from organic silk.
questions.explanation: Biến đổi từ câu ghép với mạo từ bất định 'an elaborate costume' thành mệnh đề quan hệ xác định với 'The elaborate costume that...'.

questions.original_sentence: The carnival had such a captivating atmosphere that thousands of tourists joined the street parade.
questions.cue: The atmosphere of the carnival was so
questions.correct_answer: The atmosphere of the carnival was so captivating that thousands of tourists joined the street parade.
acceptable_answers: The atmosphere of the carnival was so captivating that thousands of tourists joined the street parade.
questions.explanation: Chuyển cấu trúc 'such a + adj + noun' sang 'so + adj + that' với cụm danh từ xác định 'The atmosphere of the carnival'.

questions.original_sentence: Learning to play the violin requires more patience than learning any other musical instrument.
questions.correct_answer: The violin is the most demanding musical instrument to learn.
acceptable_answers: The violin is the most demanding musical instrument to learn.
The violin is the most difficult musical instrument to learn.
questions.explanation: Dùng mạo từ 'the' cho nhạc cụ đại diện cả loài/loại nhạc cụ ('The violin') kết hợp so sánh nhất 'the most demanding musical instrument'.

questions.original_sentence: It is difficult for many exchange students to overcome a language barrier in an unfamiliar city.
questions.correct_answer: Overcoming a language barrier in an unfamiliar city is difficult for many exchange students.
acceptable_answers: Overcoming a language barrier in an unfamiliar city is difficult for many exchange students.
questions.explanation: Biến đổi cấu trúc 'It is adj for sb to V' thành danh từ/danh động từ làm chủ ngữ 'Overcoming a language barrier...'.

questions.original_sentence: The Pacific Ocean is wider and deeper than any other ocean on earth.
questions.correct_answer: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on earth.
acceptable_answers: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on earth.
The Pacific Ocean is the biggest ocean on earth.
questions.explanation: Giữ nguyên mạo từ 'The' trước tên đại dương và áp dụng so sánh nhất 'the largest and deepest ocean on earth'.

questions.original_sentence: Children always feel thrilled when they take part in trick or treat on Halloween night.
questions.correct_answer: Taking part in trick or treat on Halloween night always makes children feel thrilled.
acceptable_answers: Taking part in trick or treat on Halloween night always makes children feel thrilled.
Taking part in trick or treat on Halloween night brings great excitement to children.
questions.explanation: Chuyển thành danh động từ làm chủ ngữ với cụm từ không mạo từ 'trick or treat' và 'Halloween night'.

ex5_guided_cloze.title: Exercise 5: Guided Cloze Passages
ex5_guided_cloze.instruction: Read the following passages and choose the best option (A, B, C, or D) for each numbered blank, applying target grammar rules and context vocabulary.

passages.title: Embracing Cultural Diversity: The International Youth Festival
passages.content:
Every autumn, our university hosts an international festival to celebrate cultural diversity and global unity. Students from more than thirty nations gather in (1) ______ central courtyard to showcase their native heritage. The opening ceremony begins with an impressive procession where participants wear (2) ______ traditional costumes adorned with intricate folk embroidery. Walking through the campus, visitors encounter (3) ______ vibrant atmosphere filled with music and laughter.

At the entrance, an information booth provides visitors with (4) ______ helpful guide outlining the schedule of performances. One of the main attractions is (5) ______ music stage, where talented students perform on various instruments. Last year, a student from Ha Noi mesmerised the audience by playing (6) ______ bamboo flute, while a classmate from Spain accompanied her on (7) ______ guitar. This creative collaboration proved that music easily bridges (8) ______ language barrier among young people.

Nearby, a dedicated pavilion highlights the cultural traditions of Southeast Asia. Visitors can try their hand at (9) ______ bamboo dancing, a traditional game that requires agility and rhythm. Although it initially seemed (10) ______ unfamiliar activity to many international guests, local students patiently explained each step. In the main hall, educators delivered a lecture on how (11) ______ globalisation influences contemporary youth lifestyles. They emphasized that while adopting global trends, preserving (12) ______ cultural identity remains essential for every community.

For students studying abroad, adapting to a new society can occasionally cause (13) ______ culture shock. However, participating in such extracurricular activities provides (14) ______ wonderful opportunity to form lasting friendships. During the festival, guests also explored a charity booth offering hand-made souvenirs. A young volunteer explained that (15) ______ proceeds from selling these souvenirs would support rural schools in (16) ______ northern mountainous provinces. As dusk fell, everyone gathered around the outdoor stage to admire (17) ______ moon rising above the university library. The festival concluded with (18) ______ grand fireworks display that illuminated (19) ______ entire campus. It was truly (20) ______ unforgettable celebration of multicultural harmony.

questions.explanation: Sân trung tâm của trường là địa điểm xác định duy nhất trong bối cảnh khuôn viên trường, dùng 'the'.
Danh từ số nhiều 'traditional costumes' mang ý nghĩa khái quát chung, dùng zero article (Ø).
Cụm danh từ đếm được số ít 'vibrant atmosphere' lần đầu được giới thiệu, bắt đầu bằng phụ âm /v/, dùng 'a'.
'Helpful guide' là danh từ đếm được số ít, 'helpful' bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm /h/, dùng 'a'.
Sân khấu âm nhạc chính của lễ hội là thực thể xác định cụ thể trong khuôn viên, dùng 'the'.
Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước tên nhạc cụ khi chơi ('playing the bamboo flute').
Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước tên nhạc cụ đi cùng giới từ chỉ phương tiện âm nhạc ('on the guitar').
Cụm từ mang ý nghĩa 'một rào cản ngôn ngữ' nói chung, dùng mạo từ bất định 'a'.
Tên điệu nhảy truyền thống hoặc trò chơi dân gian (bamboo dancing) dùng zero article (Ø).
'Unfamiliar activity' là danh từ đếm được số ít với tính từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm /ʌ/, dùng 'an'.
'Globalisation' là danh từ trừu tượng không đếm được dùng với ý nghĩa khái quát, dùng zero article (Ø).
'Cultural identity' là danh từ không đếm được chỉ bản sắc văn hóa nói chung, dùng zero article (Ø).
'Culture shock' là danh từ không đếm được chỉ hiện tượng sốc văn hóa nói chung, dùng zero article (Ø).
Danh từ số ít đếm được 'opportunity' đi sau tính từ bắt đầu bằng phụ âm 'wonderful', dùng 'a'.
'Proceeds' (tiền thu được) được xác định cụ thể bởi cụm 'from selling these souvenirs', nên dùng 'the'.
Dùng 'the' trước cụm danh từ chỉ các vùng miền địa lý cụ thể ('the northern mountainous provinces').
'The moon' là thiên thể duy nhất trong tự nhiên, luôn dùng mạo từ xác định 'the'.
Cụm danh từ đếm được số ít 'grand fireworks display' lần đầu xuất hiện, dùng mạo từ 'a'.
Toàn bộ khuôn viên trường là không gian cụ thể xác định ('the entire campus'), dùng 'the'.
Cụm danh từ số ít 'unforgettable celebration' bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm /ʌ/, dùng mạo từ 'an'.

passages.title: Global Flavours: The Journey of World Cuisines and Traditions
passages.content:
Food has always served as (21) ______ universal language that connects communities across continents. Through trade routes and modern globalisation, culinary traditions have traveled far beyond their places of (22) ______ origin. Today, walking down any bustling metropolitan street, one can observe (23) ______ diverse range of international eateries. From aromatic noodle shops to authentic Italian pizzerias, world (24) ______ cuisine has captured the hearts of modern diners.

In many tourist destinations, the night market is regarded as (25) ______ premier tourist attraction. Here, dozens of independent vendors set up (26) ______ food stall offering freshly cooked delicacies. Each vendor proudly promotes (27) ______ local speciality, preparing dishes with passion and precision. For instance, in Hue, chefs use (28) ______ shrimp paste as an essential ingredient to craft distinctive royal broths. The aroma alone is enough to captivate (29) ______ tourists who wander past.

Culinary exchange also encourages people to respect (30) ______ cultural diversity. When tourists taste unfamiliar dishes, they learn to appreciate (31) ______ customs and history embedded in each recipe. Food critics note that modern culinary trends represent (32) ______ fascinating blend of traditional heritage and contemporary innovation. A chef in London might combine British roast beef with spices imported from (33) ______ India, creating a completely new dining experience.

Festivals around the globe further celebrate these gastronomic traditions. During European carnivals, street bakers prepare sweet pastries, while in America, families celebrate autumn by carving (34) ______ pumpkin lantern and sharing pumpkin pies. On Halloween, young children wear scary costumes, visit neighbours for (35) ______ trick or treat, and explore haunted houses without any real (36) ______ cause for alarm. At the same time, communities along (37) ______ Mediterranean Sea gather for open-air feasts to celebrate the olive harvest.

Ultimately, food allows us to experience the world without crossing (38) ______ ocean. It reminds us that despite our different backgrounds, human beings share (39) ______ fundamental desire for fellowship and celebration. Embracing world cuisines is not merely a gastronomic trend; it is (40) ______ vital step toward cross-cultural understanding.

questions.explanation: Từ 'universal' bắt đầu bằng âm bán nguyên âm /juː/, do đó dùng mạo từ bất định 'a universal language'.
Cụm danh từ 'places of origin' dùng zero article (Ø) trước danh từ không đếm được/trừu tượng 'origin'.
Cụm thành ngữ chỉ số lượng/đa dạng: 'a diverse range of' (một loạt/đa dạng các...).
'World cuisine' được dùng với nghĩa khái quát chỉ nền ẩm thực thế giới nói chung, dùng zero article (Ø).
Dùng 'the' trước tính từ mang ý nghĩa tối thượng/hàng đầu ('the premier tourist attraction').
Danh từ đếm được số ít 'food stall' được nhắc đến với nghĩa 'một quầy hàng', dùng 'a'.
Danh từ đếm được số ít 'local speciality' mang nghĩa 'một đặc sản địa phương', dùng mạo từ 'a'.
'Shrimp paste' (mắm tôm) là danh từ không đếm được chỉ nguyên liệu chung, dùng zero article (Ø).
'Tourists' được xác định cụ thể bởi mệnh đề quan hệ 'who wander past', nên dùng mạo từ xác định 'the'.
'Cultural diversity' là danh từ trừu tượng không đếm được chỉ sự đa dạng văn hóa nói chung, dùng zero article (Ø).
Danh từ 'customs' được xác định bởi cụm 'embedded in each recipe', nên dùng mạo từ 'the'.
Cụm danh từ đếm được số ít 'fascinating blend' bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm /f/, dùng mạo từ 'a'.
Tên các quốc gia thông thường ở dạng số ít như India, Viet Nam không dùng mạo từ (zero article Ø).
Danh từ đếm được số ít 'pumpkin lantern' mang nghĩa chạm khắc một chiếc đèn bí ngô, dùng 'a'.
Cụm thành ngữ hoạt động lễ hội 'trick or treat' dùng zero article (Ø).
Thành ngữ cố định 'cause for alarm' (lý do để lo lắng) không đi kèm mạo từ (zero article Ø).
Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước tên các biển và đại dương (the Mediterranean Sea).
Danh từ đếm được số ít 'ocean' bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm /ˈəʊʃn/, dùng mạo từ 'an'.
Cụm danh từ đếm được số ít 'fundamental desire' bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm /f/, dùng mạo từ 'a'.
Cụm danh từ đếm được số ít 'vital step' bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm /v/, dùng mạo từ 'a'.

ex6_error_identification.title: Exercise 6: Error Identification & Correction
ex6_error_identification.instruction: Identify the bracketed part (A, B, C, or D) that contains a grammatical error in each sentence, then provide the correct form.

questions.text: When we traveled across [A: the Viet Nam] last summer, we visited [B: an ancient temple] and admired [C: the stunning architecture] of [D: the imperial citadel].
questions.explanation: Tên hầu hết các quốc gia ở dạng số ít đơn lẻ (như Viet Nam, Japan) không dùng mạo từ 'the'.

questions.text: My older brother is learning to play [A: guitar] at [B: a youth club], while my sister [C: is practicing] the bamboo flute for [D: an upcoming competition].
questions.explanation: Dùng mạo từ 'the' trước danh từ chỉ nhạc cụ khi đi cùng động từ 'play' hoặc 'learn to play' ('play the guitar').

questions.text: Millions of international travelers visit [A: the Philippines] every year to relax on [B: pristine beaches] and explore marine life in [C: Pacific] [D: Ocean].
questions.explanation: Tên các đại dương luôn phải có mạo từ xác định 'the' phía trước ('the Pacific Ocean').

questions.text: During the highland carnival, local students [A: wore] authentic costumes and [B: enthusiastically played] [C: the tug of war] on [D: the village square].
questions.explanation: Tên các trò chơi thể thao dân gian truyền thống (như tug of war, football) không đi kèm mạo từ 'the'.

questions.text: The mountaineering team traveled to [A: the Mount Everest] to conduct research on glaciers, but they encountered [B: an unexpected blizzard] near [C: the base camp] [D: yesterday].
questions.explanation: Tên các ngọn núi đơn lẻ (như Mount Everest, Mount Fansipan) không dùng mạo từ 'the'.

questions.text: [A: The globalisation] has created [B: unprecedented opportunities] for youth across developing countries to participate in [C: international] [D: culture exchange].
questions.explanation: 'Globalisation' là danh từ trừu tượng không đếm được dùng với ý nghĩa khái quát toàn cầu, không dùng mạo từ 'the'.

questions.text: She purchased [A: an unique] souvenir at [B: the night market] to remind herself of [C: the memorable trip] to [D: the ancient town].
questions.explanation: Tính từ 'unique' bắt đầu bằng âm bán nguyên âm /juː/, vì vậy phải dùng mạo từ 'a' thay vì 'an'.

questions.text: After exploring [A: the Louvre Museum] in [B: the Paris], the exchange students enjoyed lunch at [C: a traditional bistro] near [D: the Seine River].
questions.explanation: Tên các thành phố (như Paris, Ha Noi, London) không sử dụng mạo từ xác định 'the'.

questions.text: Last Saturday evening, our entire family [A: had] [B: a dinner] at [C: a bustling food stall] that serves [D: authentic Hue specialities].
questions.explanation: Tên các bữa ăn thông thường trong ngày không có tính từ bổ nghĩa phía trước thì không dùng mạo từ 'a' ('had dinner').

questions.text: The environmentalists crossed [A: the Sahara Desert] to assess [B: the severe impact of droughts] on wildlife in [C: northern] [D: an Africa].
questions.explanation: Tên các châu lục (như Africa, Asia, Europe) không dùng mạo từ.

ex7_sentence_combination.title: Exercise 7: Sentence Combination
ex7_sentence_combination.instruction: Combine each pair of sentences into a single, coherent sentence using the target grammatical structure indicated.

questions.sentence_1: The annual carnival features a captivating blend of traditional music.
questions.sentence_2: It attracts thousands of international spectators every year.
questions.correct_answer: The annual carnival features a captivating blend of traditional music, which attracts thousands of international spectators every year.
acceptable_answers: The annual carnival features a captivating blend of traditional music, which attracts thousands of international spectators every year.
The annual carnival, which features a captivating blend of traditional music, attracts thousands of international spectators every year.
questions.explanation: Dùng đại từ quan hệ 'which' tạo mệnh đề quan hệ bổ nghĩa cho mệnh đề hoặc danh từ phía trước.

questions.sentence_1: The local chef used an organic secret ingredient.
questions.sentence_2: The speciality dish became the highlight of the food festival.
questions.correct_answer: Because the local chef used an organic secret ingredient, the speciality dish became the highlight of the food festival.
acceptable_answers: Because the local chef used an organic secret ingredient, the speciality dish became the highlight of the food festival.
The speciality dish became the highlight of the food festival because the local chef used an organic secret ingredient.
questions.explanation: Dùng liên từ 'Because' chỉ nguyên nhân kết quả, kết hợp chính xác mạo từ 'an organic secret ingredient' và 'the speciality dish'.

questions.sentence_2: It also promotes cultural diversity among modern youth.
questions.correct_answer: Not only does globalisation expand international economic trade, but it also promotes cultural diversity among modern youth.
acceptable_answers: Not only does globalisation expand international economic trade, but it also promotes cultural diversity among modern youth.
Globalisation not only expands international economic trade but also promotes cultural diversity among modern youth.
questions.explanation: Dùng cấu trúc đảo ngữ với 'Not only does... but it also...' hoặc cấu trúc song hành nối hai vị ngữ.

questions.sentence_1: Students learn more about unfamiliar customs.
questions.sentence_2: They appreciate cultural diversity more deeply.
questions.correct_answer: The more students learn about unfamiliar customs, the more deeply they appreciate cultural diversity.
acceptable_answers: The more students learn about unfamiliar customs, the more deeply they appreciate cultural diversity.
The more they learn about unfamiliar customs, the more students appreciate cultural diversity.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh kép 'The more + S + V, the more + S + V' thể hiện mối tương quan tăng tiến.

questions.sentence_1: The young musicians formed a multicultural ensemble.
questions.sentence_2: They wanted to overcome language barriers through their art.
questions.correct_answer: The young musicians formed a multicultural ensemble in order to overcome language barriers through their art.
acceptable_answers: The young musicians formed a multicultural ensemble in order to overcome language barriers through their art.
In order to overcome language barriers through their art, the young musicians formed a multicultural ensemble.
questions.explanation: Dùng cụm chỉ mục đích 'in order to + V' để nối hai câu có chung chủ ngữ.

questions.sentence_1: The ancient citadel is a renowned tourist attraction.
questions.sentence_2: It was recognised as a World Cultural Heritage Site by UNESCO.
questions.correct_answer: The ancient citadel, which is a renowned tourist attraction, was recognised as a World Cultural Heritage Site by UNESCO.
acceptable_answers: The ancient citadel, which is a renowned tourist attraction, was recognised as a World Cultural Heritage Site by UNESCO.
The ancient citadel is a renowned tourist attraction which was recognised as a World Cultural Heritage Site by UNESCO.
questions.explanation: Sử dụng mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định với 'which' để bổ sung thông tin cho chủ ngữ 'The ancient citadel'.

questions.sentence_1: Children dressed in creative Halloween costumes.
questions.sentence_2: They eagerly went trick or treating across the neighbourhood.
questions.correct_answer: Dressed in creative Halloween costumes, the children eagerly went trick or treating across the neighbourhood.
acceptable_answers: Dressed in creative Halloween costumes, the children eagerly went trick or treating across the neighbourhood.
questions.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề đồng chủ ngữ thành cụm quá khứ phân từ 'Dressed in creative Halloween costumes'.

questions.sentence_1: The exchange student experienced severe culture shock at first.
questions.sentence_2: She quickly adapted to the multicultural lifestyle in the United Kingdom.
questions.correct_answer: Although the exchange student experienced severe culture shock at first, she quickly adapted to the multicultural lifestyle in the United Kingdom.
acceptable_answers: Although the exchange student experienced severe culture shock at first, she quickly adapted to the multicultural lifestyle in the United Kingdom.
The exchange student quickly adapted to the multicultural lifestyle in the United Kingdom although she experienced severe culture shock at first.
questions.explanation: Dùng liên từ nhượng bộ 'Although' nối hai mệnh đề có ý nghĩa tương phản.

questions.sentence_1: Playing a traditional game like tug of war builds physical endurance.
questions.sentence_2: It also reinforces teamwork during school festivities.
questions.correct_answer: Besides building physical endurance, playing a traditional game like tug of war reinforces teamwork during school festivities.
acceptable_answers: Besides building physical endurance, playing a traditional game like tug of war reinforces teamwork during school festivities.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'Besides + V-ing' để bổ sung thêm lợi ích của hoạt động trò chơi dân gian.

questions.sentence_1: The internet connects individuals from diverse backgrounds.
questions.sentence_2: It allows young people to appreciate cultural differences effortlessly.
questions.correct_answer: By connecting individuals from diverse backgrounds, the internet allows young people to appreciate cultural differences effortlessly.
acceptable_answers: By connecting individuals from diverse backgrounds, the internet allows young people to appreciate cultural differences effortlessly.
questions.explanation: Dùng giới từ 'By + V-ing' diễn đạt phương tiện / cách thức mà 'the internet' tạo điều kiện cho giới trẻ.

ex8_sentence_building.title: Exercise 8: Sentence Building from Cues
ex8_sentence_building.instruction: Use the given cue words to write complete, grammatically correct sentences, inserting appropriate articles (a, an, the, or Ø) and necessary prepositions or verb inflections.

questions.cues: globalisation / create / many / opportunity / for / youth / participate / culture exchange
questions.correct_answer: Globalisation creates many opportunities for youth to participate in culture exchange.
acceptable_answers: Globalisation creates many opportunities for youth to participate in culture exchange.
Globalisation has created many opportunities for youth to participate in culture exchange.
questions.explanation: 'Globalisation' dùng zero article, 'youth' chỉ giới trẻ nói chung, thêm giới từ 'in' sau 'participate'.

questions.cues: while / travel / across / United Kingdom / exchange / student / experience / culture shock
questions.correct_answer: While traveling across the United Kingdom, the exchange students experienced culture shock.
acceptable_answers: While traveling across the United Kingdom, the exchange students experienced culture shock.
While traveling across the United Kingdom, an exchange student experienced culture shock.
questions.explanation: Thêm 'the' trước 'United Kingdom', 'the exchange students' và zero article trước 'culture shock'.

questions.cues: participating / traditional game / like / tug of war / be / great / extracurricular activity
questions.correct_answer: Participating in a traditional game like tug of war is a great extracurricular activity.
acceptable_answers: Participating in a traditional game like tug of war is a great extracurricular activity.
questions.explanation: Thêm giới từ 'in', mạo từ 'a traditional game', zero article trước 'tug of war', và 'a great extracurricular activity'.

questions.cues: during / autumn / festival / children / carry / pumpkin lantern / and / wear / costume
questions.correct_answer: During the autumn festival, children carried pumpkin lanterns and wore colourful costumes.
acceptable_answers: During the autumn festival, children carried pumpkin lanterns and wore colourful costumes.
During the autumn festival, children carry pumpkin lanterns and wear colourful costumes.
questions.explanation: Thêm 'the' trước 'autumn festival', dạng số nhiều 'pumpkin lanterns' và 'colourful costumes' dùng zero article.

questions.cues: local / chef / use / fresh / ingredient / to / prepare / unique / speciality / of / region
questions.correct_answer: The local chef used fresh ingredients to prepare a unique speciality of the region.
acceptable_answers: The local chef used fresh ingredients to prepare a unique speciality of the region.
The local chef uses fresh ingredients to prepare the unique speciality of the region.
questions.explanation: Thêm 'The' trước 'local chef', zero article trước danh từ số nhiều 'fresh ingredients', 'a unique speciality' và 'the region'.

questions.cues: ancient / town / be / popular / tourist attraction / which / attract / visitors / all / over / world
questions.correct_answer: The ancient town is a popular tourist attraction which attracts visitors from all over the world.
acceptable_answers: The ancient town is a popular tourist attraction which attracts visitors from all over the world.
questions.explanation: Thêm 'The ancient town', 'a popular tourist attraction', và cụm cố định 'from all over the world'.

questions.cues: she / buy / hand-crafted / souvenir / at / night market / after / enjoy / local / cuisine
questions.correct_answer: She bought a hand-crafted souvenir at the night market after enjoying the local cuisine.
acceptable_answers: She bought a hand-crafted souvenir at the night market after enjoying the local cuisine.
She bought a hand-crafted souvenir at the night market after enjoying local cuisine.
questions.explanation: Thêm mạo từ 'a hand-crafted souvenir', 'the night market' và 'the local cuisine' (hoặc zero article).

questions.cues: learning / to / play / flute / help / student / appreciate / cultural identity
questions.correct_answer: Learning to play the flute helps students appreciate their cultural identity.
acceptable_answers: Learning to play the flute helps students appreciate their cultural identity.
Learning to play the flute helps students appreciate cultural identity.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'the' trước tên nhạc cụ 'the flute', chia động từ 'helps' theo danh động từ 'Learning'.

questions.cues: expedition / team / sail / across / Pacific Ocean / to / study / marine / life
questions.correct_answer: The expedition team sailed across the Pacific Ocean to study marine life.
acceptable_answers: The expedition team sailed across the Pacific Ocean to study marine life.
questions.explanation: Thêm mạo từ xác định 'The expedition team', 'the Pacific Ocean' và zero article trước 'marine life'.

questions.cues: entering / dark / haunted house / during / carnival / be / not / cause for alarm
questions.correct_answer: Entering a dark haunted house during the carnival was not a cause for alarm.
acceptable_answers: Entering a dark haunted house during the carnival was not a cause for alarm.
Entering a dark haunted house during the carnival is not a cause for alarm.
questions.explanation: Thêm 'a dark haunted house', 'the carnival', và cụm vị ngữ 'not a cause for alarm'.
